subject: The rules are versioned and a session's reading of them is not
recordedOccasion: after a session followed a rule that had been replaced four revisions earlier and the owner asked how it had missed it.
severity: F1 is the mechanism and is moderate -- it costs a wrong rule followed confidently, which is worse than a rule not found. F2 is the instrument that exists for it and has never been in a position to fire.
scope: session management. The fix is one field, one comparison, and arming a watch that already exists.
read: .claude/settings.json, and the hook events it does not use

members.statement: A session records what it read and never which version, so nothing can tell it a rule has moved
members.sectionHeading: F1 — a read is a point-in-time fact and the record does not treat it as one

members.statement: The instrument that would say so is critical, correct, and has never been armed
members.sectionHeading: F2 — the watch is correct, critical, and has never been armed

members.statement: No watch covers references/, docs/rules/, or most of docs/architecture/
members.sectionHeading: F3 — the categories a reader most needs watched have no watch at all

decisions.decision: Every watch is armed, and a watch that has never been armed is reported as a defect rather than as a state
decisions.sectionHeading: D1 — arm them, and make an unarmed watch a defect

decisions.decision: references/, docs/rules/ and the unwatched architecture records and ledgers get watches, against the instruction sets, prompts and configs they describe
decisions.sectionHeading: D2 — watch the categories that describe something else

decisions.decision: A session records the blob it read each foundational document at, and refresh becomes a comparison rather than a re-read
decisions.sectionHeading: D3 — the missing operand is the baseline, not the hash

decisions.decision: The notification is a hook that injects and never blocks, and it is built last
decisions.sectionHeading: D4 — a hook that injects, never blocks, and comes last

decisions.decision: D2's scope crossed the tree line. This bundle decides watches over what it governs; the toolkit's documents are the toolkit set's to decide, and are parked as a cross-cutting bundle
decisions.sectionHeading: D5 — the scope crossed the tree line, and carrying it out is what showed it

edges.why: the session-rules watch is 0050 F4's first member; this is what its not firing produced
both are a rule that was present and not consulted, from opposite causes -- one stale, one never checked
until the coverage sweep can see references/ and docs/rules/, watches added there cannot be checked for completeness

indexNotes: Assigned 2026-09-09 and read on assignment. Four decisions, and the order they are carried out in is the decision that matters
